item.title: Long Beach Community College District to pay $18M to settle adjunct lawsuit
item.description: If a judge gives final approval, the settlement will result in 1,456 class members receiving more than $11,000 each, according to court filings. The post Long Beach Community College District to pay $18M to settle adjunct lawsuit appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Japanese skateboarding show will take over dirt pit where City Hall once stood
item.description: KASSO challenges skaters to conquer extravagant obstacle courses. In its first event outside Japan, it’s producing and broadcasting a two-day festival in Long Beach. The post Japanese skateboarding show will take over dirt pit where City Hall once stood appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: How one Long Beach resident’s $2,200 medical bill got erased
item.description: So far, an L.A. County pilot program has abolished more than $363 million in unpaid medical bills, for 170,000 residents. The post How one Long Beach resident’s $2,200 medical bill got erased appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: State Sen. Gonzalez pushes for speed cameras on PCH in Long Beach, one of the city’s deadliest roads
item.description: This would be on top of 18 speed cameras Long Beach already plans to install in other parts of the city. The post State Sen. Gonzalez pushes for speed cameras on PCH in Long Beach, one of the city’s deadliest roads appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Brother and sister were among the 4 killed in fiery wreck at Long Beach Airport underpass
item.description: Authorities have now released the identities of all four of the victims. They were all in their 20s. The post Brother and sister were among the 4 killed in fiery wreck at Long Beach Airport underpass appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: LA’s best new Peruvian restaurant is hiding in a Lakewood backyard
item.description: Lomo Fuego is a fully licensed Peruvian restaurant operating out of a family home, and it's part of a quietly growing movement reshaping how a restaurant is defined. The post LA’s best new Peruvian restaurant is hiding in a Lakewood backyard appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Tariffs aren’t slowing down a soaring Long Beach Port, but consumers and businesses feel the pinch
item.description: The uncertainty hasn't stopped record-breaking cargo volumes. But with the costs being passed on, smaller businesses say they’re freezing hiring and running out of stockpiled inventory. The post Tariffs aren’t slowing down a soaring Long Beach Port, but consumers and businesses feel the pinch appeared first on Long Beach Post.
